Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Treatment of isolated facial nerve palsy (Bell's palsy)

Preferred:

Doxycycline 100 mg PO q12h ($) [DI]
For pregnant patients or those with contraindications to doxycycline: Amoxicillin 500 mg PO q8h ($) [R]

### Treatment of neurological disease other than facial nerve palsy (Bell's palsy)

Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) [M]

*Local guidance (Omaha CDSS, Inpatient):*
Duration of therapy
Treat for at least 14 days. Longer durations, up to 21 days for facial nerve palsy and 28 days for other neurologic disease, may be required in severe cases.
Neurological disease is a common manifestation of Lyme Disease that typically occurs within weeks to months after the tick bite. Unilateral or bilateral facial nerve palsy (Bell's palsy) can be treated with oral antimicrobials. Other neurological manifestations, including meningitis, require treatment with intravenous antimicrobials.
